The '''Kultech KP-009''' model [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]] was found in a standard [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Utility belt/Legends|field-utility belt]]. It came with a factory-guaranteed range of 100 [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] and could produce a shroud of white-noise to prevent eavesdroppers.
